stem.text: Which compound forms a precipitate when mixed with 2,4-DNPH reagent and also forms a precipitate when mixed with Fehling’s reagent?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexenone with a methyl group on the C=C carbon and a prop-1-en-2-yl group

B.alt: Skeletal formula of an aldehyde with a chain ending in a tertiary alcohol group (C(CH3)2OH)

C.alt: Skeletal formula of an ester: an alkenyl (C=C) group linked through O to an ethanoyl group

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclopentanone with an alkenyl side chain and a CH2CO2CH3 group
